name: Install Init Wrapper
description: Writes /usr/local/sbin/proxvex-init into the container rootfs (offline via vol_mount, container still stopped) when unprivileged_port_start, container_sysctls or ipv6_token is set. In an oci-image app the service itself is PID 1, so there is no step inside the container before the app, and Proxmox rejects the direct route for per-netns sysctls (raw lxc.sysctl.* keys are dropped from the config). The wrapper sets net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start (lets a non-root app bind ports below 1024 — which is why local_https_port otherwise defaults to 1443) and every key=value line of container_sysctls (e.g. net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 for a VPN gateway), and pins eth0's IPv6 interface ID to ipv6_token (ip token set — the default ID follows the MAC, which changes on upgrade), then execs the original command; conf-oci-lxc-configuration.py points the container's init at it. No-op when all three are empty.
